ul.ysu-sidebar-list a:hover { background-color: #990c23 }

span.ysu-anchor {display: block; position: relative; top: -180px; visibility: hidden; }

p.ysu-staff-box-title {font-size: 0.9rem; text-align: center; padding-bottom: 8px; border-bottom: 1px solid #666666;}

.ysu-story-detail-box {border: 1px solid #d9d9db; background-color: whitesmoke; color: #000000; padding: 15px}

.ysu-left-red-border {border-left: 10px solid #c8102e; padding-left: 10px;}
.ysu-thin-bottom-red-border {border-bottom: 3px solid #c8102e; padding-bottom: 5px;}

.ysu-staff-bio-shadow { float: left; margin: 15px 15px; width: calc(50% - 30px); min-height: 185px; box-shadow: 0 2px 6px 0 rgba(0, 0, 0, 0.4); background-color: #fff;}
.ysu-staff-bio-shadow-blank { float: left; margin: 15px 15px; width: calc(50% - 30px); min-height: 185px; box-shadow: 0 2px 6px 0 rgba(0, 0, 0, 0.4); background-color: #fff}

.ysu-staff-bio-shadow picture,
.ysu-staff-bio-shadow img {
float: left;   
  width: 200px;                /* desktop fixed width */
  height: auto !important;
  margin: 0px 15px 0px 0px;     /* center horizontally, small gap below */
}

/* NovaCare badge below links */
.novacare-badge {
  text-align: center;
  margin-top: 12px;
}

.novacare-badge img {
  max-width: 100px;  /* desktop size */
  height: auto;
  display: inline-block;
}

.ysu-staff-firstname {font-size: 1.2em; font-weight: 700; 
  margin: 0px 15px 0px 0px;}
.ysu-staff-lastname {font-weight: 700; font-size: 1.6em;}
.ysu-staff-lastname::after {content: ""; display: block; width: 60px; height: 2px; background-color: #c8102e; margin: 6px 0px 0px 215px;}

}

  max-width: 150px;      /* scale down if too large */

}

  margin: 0 0 8px;

  display: inline-block;
}

.ysu-staff-bio-rightcol .profile-text {
  flex: 1;
 margin: 4px 0;
}

 display: flex;

 gap: 0.5rem;
}

.ysu-inline-round-list > li {
  margin: 2px;
}
.ysu-inline-round-list > li > a {
  display: inline-block;
  background-color: #c8102e;
  color: #fff;
  border: none;
  font-weight: bold;
  font-size: 0.875rem;
  padding: 0.35rem 1rem;
  text-decoration: none;
  border-radius: 8px;
  transition: background-color 0.3s ease, box-shadow 0.3s ease;
  white-space: normal;
  word-break: break-word;
}
.ysu-inline-round-list > li > a:hover,
.ysu-inline-round-list > li > a:active {
  background: #990c23;
  color: white;
  box-shadow: 0 4px 8px rgba(0, 0, 0, 0.2);

.ysu-inline-round-list-center {
  list-style: none;       /* remove bullets */

  display: inline-block;  /* shrink list width to fit content */
  text-align: center;     /* center text inside items if needed */
}

.ysu-inline-round-list-center li {
  display: inline-block;  /* align items side by side */
  margin: 10px 15px;         /* spacing between items */
}

  display: inline-block;
  padding: 8px 12px;      /* spacing inside link */

  color: #fff;            /* white text */

}

.ysu-inline-round-list-center li a:hover {
  background: #990c23;    /* darker red on hover */
}

    display: inline-block;

    border-radius: 6px;
    font-size: .75rem;
    margin: .4rem 0rem;
}

  position: relative;

  left: 50%;

  margin-right: -50vw;
}

    height: auto;
  }

    max-width: 80px;
    margin: 0px 0px 15px 15px;

@media only screen and (max-width: 600px) {

    <script>
        require(["config"], function () {
            require(["knockout", "jquery"], function (ko, $) {
                var sport = "wsoc",
                    year = "2025";

                $('a[data-player-id]').click(function () {
                    var player_id = $(this).data("player-id");

                    var vm = function () {
                        var self = this;

                        self.bio = ko.observable({});
                        self.stats = ko.observable({});
                        self.open = ko.observable(true);
                        self.loading = ko.observable(true);
                            
                        self.closeDialog = function () {
                            self.open(false);
                            dialog.remove();
                        };

						$(document).keydown(function(e) {
							 if (e.keyCode === 27) {
								self.closeDialog();
							}
						});

                        self.getStats = function () {
                            $.getJSON('/services/roster_bio_stats.ashx', { 'rp_id': player_id, 'sport': sport, 'year': year }, function (response) {
                                self.bio(response.bio);
                                self.stats(response.stats);
                                self.loading(false);
								dialog.find('.content .stats .sidearm-table').DataTable({ paging: false, searching: false, info: false, aaSorting: [] }); // column sorting
                            });
                        }

                        self.isGoalie = ko.computed(function () {
                            if (self.stats() && self.stats().goalie_game_by_game_stats && self.stats().goalie_game_by_game_stats.length > 0)
                                return true;
                            else
                                return false;
                        });

                        self.getStats();
                    };

                    var dialog = $('.player-bio.dialog').clone();
                    $('.sidearm-cume-stats').append(dialog);
                    ko.applyBindings(vm, dialog[0]);

                    return false;
                });
            });
        });
    </script>
